rows.description: We stand for the anthem because the teacher says so and I do it without thinking. Over time I learn it is a way of showing respect, not just a rule to fear.

rows.description: I giggle during the anthem because friends do. It is easy to copy others; I learn that respect for shared symbols matters to many, and that I can save jokes for another time.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: awe, confusion, pride, respect
related mind states: amusement, admiration

rows.description: I hear a story of a soldier or freedom fighter and feel awed at their courage. Admiration can inspire me to serve in my own small ways, like honesty and helping the community.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: confusion, mockery, pride, respect
related mind states: admiration, awe

rows.description: A classmate of another region or faith says he too loves the country. I see that loving one's land is not owned by any one group, and I welcome him as a fellow citizen.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: awe, confusion, mockery, respect
related mind states: affection, pride

rows.description: I hear elders argue angrily about the country and leaders. It confuses me. I can listen, ask calm questions, and understand that respect for the nation does not mean everyone must think alike.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: awe, mockery, pride, respect
related mind states: admiration, confusion, calm

rows.description: I see someone litter near the flag or a monument and feel uneasy. Civic respect means caring for shared places too; I can pick it up or gently remind someone.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: awe, confusion, mockery, pride
related mind states: admiration, anxiety

rows.description: I receive weekly pocket money and feel grown up. Gratitude means remembering it comes from my parents' hard work, and thoughtful spending shows I value it.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, generosity, manipulation, pride, trust

rows.description: I see a toy and spend my whole allowance in a minute, then feel regret. This is how children learn; waiting a day before buying teaches me to tell wanting from needing.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, generosity, gratitude, manipulation, pride, trust
related mind states: regret

rows.description: I saved for months and bought a cricket bat with my own money. The pride is deep. Saving teaches patience and shows me that effort builds what I want.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: envy, generosity, gratitude, manipulation, trust
related mind states: pride

rows.description: My friend gets much more pocket money and buys many things. I feel a pang. It helps to remember that families differ, and to value what I have instead of comparing.
graph_context: same situation, other stances at this age: generosity, gratitude, manipulation, pride, trust
related mind states: envy
